We are pleased to announce the opening of the Digital Humanities Center at the University of Bern.

- **Date:** 15 September 2026
- **Start:** 15:15
- **Location:** Unitobler, University of Bern

## Program

| Time  | Session |
| --- | --- |
| 15:15 | Welcome to the grand opening |
| 15:25 | Official opening by Nicolas Detering (President of the WB Kolleg) & Claus Beisbart (Dean of the Faculty of Humanities) |
| 15:40 | "How everything started" – Prof. Dr. Tara Andrews (University of Wien)|
| 16:00 | A look at our projects — fruit and water; project pitches in the foyer (2 min. per project) |
| 16:50 | "DH Bern from the outside" – Inputs from the Digital Humanities in Genève, Lausanne, and Basel |
| 17:10 | "Many Futures" – Prof. Dr. Elena Spadini |
| 17:30 | "Meanings of a Center" by Prof. Dr. Tobias Hodel |
| 17:45 | Apéro riche and the opportunity to talk to DH, DSL, and Open Science people |
